summary: Notion gives eligible college/university students and teachers a free individual Education plan for a one-member workspace, with unlimited pages, blocks and file uploads, 30-day version history and up to 100 guests. Eligibility requires an education institution email per the WHED. You must re-verify your status with your school email once a year; if you can no longer verify a valid education email, the workspace and content move to the Free plan.
claim_steps: Use your active WHED-recognized institution email as the main email on your Notion account, and keep only one workspace member for the individual Education plan.
Go to Settings → Upgrade plan → Get free Education plan.
If your school is recognized, the upgrade applies automatically. If you meet the requirements but the option is missing, use the support contact linked in Notion's education help page.
Re-verify your education status with your school email once a year to keep the Education plan. If verification fails, the workspace moves to the Free plan.

social_proof.title: Get the Education Plan for students & teachers
social_proof.text: The Education Plan for individual students and teachers: a free plan for a one-member workspace. Up to 100 guests per workspace. To stay on the plan, verify your student status once a year with your school email.
